records.student_passage: This summer vacation, I did a part-time job in KFC. Because there was a lot of works to do, so I was very busy every day. At work, I asked to be on time, in uniform and smile to every customer. At the peak of the meal, not only did I had to do my own job properly, but also I had to cooperate well with my colleagues. At the end of a busy day’s work, I was very tiring. A month passed quick. This experience taught me a lot of knowledge what I couldn’t learn in class. For the one time I really understood the meaning of labor. Now I want to make a earlier career planning for me.
